<style>

/* =========================================================
   ÁREA PRINCIPAL
   ========================================================= */

.publicacoes-container {
  max-width: 1150px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}


/* =========================================================
   CARDS DE CATEGORIAS
   ========================================================= */

.pub-categorias {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 10px 0 35px 0;
}

.pub-card {
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 22px 15px;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid #e3e6e8;
  transition:
    transform 0.18s ease,
    box-shadow 0.18s ease,
    border-color 0.18s ease;
}

.pub-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.pub-card.ativo {
  border-color: currentColor;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px currentColor;
}


/* =========================================================
   ÍCONES
   ========================================================= */

.pub-icon-box {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  margin: 0 auto 10px auto;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  font-size: 25px;
}

.pub-card-titulo {
  font-weight: 650;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.pub-card-numero {
  margin-top: 3px;
  font-size: 0.80rem;
  opacity: 0.72;
}


/* =========================================================
   CORES
   ========================================================= */

.card-artigo {
  background: #f5f9ff;
  color: #1769aa;
}

.card-artigo .pub-icon-box {
  background: #ddecff;
}


.card-capitulo {
  background: #f4fbf7;
  color: #18845c;
}

.card-capitulo .pub-icon-box {
  background: #daf3e5;
}


.card-livro {
  background: #faf7ff;
  color: #7653af;
}

.card-livro .pub-icon-box {
  background: #eee5ff;
}


.card-divulgacao {
  background: #fff9f2;
  color: #c56b19;
}

.card-divulgacao .pub-icon-box {
  background: #ffe9d3;
}


/* =========================================================
   CABEÇALHO DA LISTA
   ========================================================= */

.pub-list-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;

  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 0;

  border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe2e5;
}

.pub-list-header h2 {
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.pub-show-all {
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: #1769aa;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.pub-show-all:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}


/* =========================================================
   PUBLICAÇÃO
   ========================================================= */

.pub-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 50px minmax(0, 1fr) 60px;
  gap: 14px;

  padding: 17px 4px;

  border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e8ea;
}


/* ícone lateral */

.pub-item-icon {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 9px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  font-size: 18px;
}


/* título */

.pub-title {
  line-height: 1.30;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.pub-title a {
  color: #155ac4;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.pub-title a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}


/* autores */

.pub-author {
  margin-top: 4px;

  font-size: 0.83rem;
  line-height: 1.35;

  color: #61666b;
}


/* detalhes */

.pub-details {
  margin-top: 3px;

  font-size: 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.35;

  color: #64696e;
}


/* ano */

.pub-year {
  text-align: right;

  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 650;

  color: #454a4f;
}


/* =========================================================
   TAG
   ========================================================= */

.pub-tag {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-top: 6px;
  padding: 2px 8px;

  border-radius: 10px;

  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 500;
}


.item-artigo .pub-item-icon,
.tag-artigo {
  background: #ddecff;
  color: #1769aa;
}

.item-capitulo .pub-item-icon,
.tag-capitulo {
  background: #daf3e5;
  color: #18845c;
}

.item-livro .pub-item-icon,
.tag-livro {
  background: #eee5ff;
  color: #7653af;
}

.item-divulgacao .pub-item-icon,
.tag-divulgacao {
  background: #ffe9d3;
  color: #c56b19;
}


/* =========================================================
   RESPONSIVO
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 800px) {

  .pub-categorias {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

}


@media (max-width: 500px) {

  .pub-categorias {
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .pub-card {
    padding: 16px 8px;
  }

  .pub-item {
    grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr;
  }

  .pub-year {
    grid-column: 2;
    text-align: left;
    margin-top: -3px;
  }

}

</style>

/* =========================================================
   CARDS
   ========================================================= */

function criarCards() {

const area = document.getElementById("pub-categorias");

Object.entries(categorias).forEach(([codigo, cat]) => {

  const n =
    publicacoes.filter(
      p => p.category === codigo
    ).length;

  const card = document.createElement("div");

  card.className =
    `pub-card card-${codigo}`;

  card.dataset.category = codigo;

  card.onclick =
    () => filtrarPublicacoes(codigo);

  card.innerHTML = `

    <div class="pub-icon-box">
      ${cat.icone}
    </div>

    <div class="pub-card-titulo">
      ${cat.nome}
    </div>

    <div class="pub-card-numero">
      ${n} ${n === 1 ? "publicação" : "publicações"}
    </div>

  `;

  area.appendChild(card);

});

}


/* =========================================================
   LISTA
   ========================================================= */

function renderizarLista(filtro = "todas") {

const area =
  document.getElementById("pub-lista");

area.innerHTML = "";


let dados = [...publicacoes];


if (filtro !== "todas") {

  dados = dados.filter(
    p => p.category === filtro
  );

}


dados.sort(
  (a, b) =>
    new Date(b.date) -
    new Date(a.date)
);


dados.forEach(pub => {

  const cat =
    categorias[pub.category];

  const ano =
    pub.date.substring(0, 4);


  const titulo =
    pub.path

      ? `<a href="${pub.path}"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer">
            ${pub.title}
         </a>`

      : pub.title;


  const item =
    document.createElement("div");


  item.className =
    `pub-item item-${pub.category}`;


  item.innerHTML = `

    <div class="pub-item-icon">
      ${cat.icone}
    </div>


    <div class="pub-info">

      <div class="pub-title">
        ${titulo}
      </div>

      <div class="pub-author">
        ${pub.author}
      </div>

      <div class="pub-details">
        ${pub.description}
      </div>

      <span class="pub-tag tag-${pub.category}">
        ${cat.singular}
      </span>

    </div>


    <div class="pub-year">
      ${ano}
    </div>

  `;


  area.appendChild(item);

});

}


/* =========================================================
   FILTRO
   ========================================================= */

function filtrarPublicacoes(categoria) {

document
  .querySelectorAll(".pub-card")
  .forEach(
    x => x.classList.remove("ativo")
  );


if (categoria === "todas") {

  document
    .getElementById("pub-titulo-lista")
    .textContent =
      "Todas as publicações";

}

else {

  const card =
    document.querySelector(
      `[data-category="${categoria}"]`
    );

  if (card) {
    card.classList.add("ativo");
  }


  document
    .getElementById("pub-titulo-lista")
    .textContent =
      categorias[categoria].nome;

}


renderizarLista(categoria);

}


/* =========================================================
   INICIAR
   ========================================================= */

criarCards();
renderizarLista();

</script>
